Read go.mod FIRST (in your context). Every name you need is in them or below; do not invent names, keys or files.

## Function Phase Loop

The state of one project's phase loop and the transitions the PM and the session drive.

Behaviour: Declares in supervisor/loop.go, exactly: `type Action struct { Kind string; Phase string; SessionID string; Resume bool; BudgetUSD float64; Line string; Milestone control.Milestone }`; `type Loop struct { Project string `json:"project"`; Queue queue.Queue `json:"queue"`; State string `json:"state"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; SessionID string `json:"session_id"`; PhaseStartedAt time.Time `json:"phase_started_at"`; Restarts []time.Time `json:"restarts"`; Stop *control.Stop `json:"stop,omitempty"`; PausedUntil time.Time `json:"paused_until"`; StretchUSD float64 `json:"stretch_usd"`; SessionUSD float64 `json:"session_usd"`; LastEventAt time.Time `json:"last_event_at"`; Nudged bool `json:"nudged"`; Alerted bool `json:"alerted"`; LastExit *control.Exit `json:"last_exit,omitempty"` }` (Restarts: the times the guard restarted the session after an exit, fresh or --resume alike, within the last hour; LastExit: the last exit the guard acted on — both written by Runtime Guard's Exited only); `type Config struct { MaxResumesPerHour int; StallMinutes int; StretchUSD float64; UsageAlertPercent int }`; `var ErrPhaseMismatch = errors.New("phase mismatch")`; `func New(project string, q queue.Queue) *Loop` (State "idle"); `func (l *Loop) Begin(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) StartChecked(s gitrules.Start, newID func() string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) PhaseDone(phase, next string) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) EndChecked(e gitrules.End, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) WaitOperator(kind, reason, issueURL string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) Continue(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) Restart(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`. State is one of "idle", "starting", "running", "paused", "waiting". A post action is Action{Kind: "post", Milestone: {kind, headline, numbers}}. An action carries only the fields its literal names here, every other field zero: start_check and end_check {Kind, Phase}; spawn {Kind, Phase, SessionID, Resume, BudgetUSD}; first_line and write {Kind, Line}; kill {Kind}; post {Kind, Milestone}. Begin (meant for State "idle" or "waiting"): Queue.Start() must succeed — its error is returned as is and nothing changes (a starting, running or paused loop holds a running queue, so a Begin there fails on the queue's state); then Phase = that id, State "starting", Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0, Restarts nil, LastExit nil (the PM's plan_load or continue starts the restart count afresh), actions [{Kind "start_check", Phase}]. StartChecked (State "starting"; any other state → nil) never touches Restarts or LastExit (a fresh start after an exit still counts, so a session that dies at once cannot restart without bound): Mode "fresh" → SessionID = newID(), PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, State "running", actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume false, BudgetUSD = the current phase''s Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator " + Phase}, {post start "<phase> started" numbers "session <id> · cap $<ClaudeUSD 'f' -1> · <Hours 'f' -1> h"}] (a Reason "pulled to …" appends " · " + Reason to the numbers); Mode "resume" with SessionID non-empty (the conversation the guard restarts after an exit) → SessionID kept, newID not called, State "running", PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume true, BudgetUSD = the current phase''s Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {post start "<phase> resumed" numbers "session <id> · " + Reason}] (no first_line); Mode "resume" with SessionID "" (no conversation to resume: the first start of a phase, the start after Restart or after an end_check''s next phase — a --resume of an unknown id is refused by claude) → the fresh transition under another post: SessionID = newID(), State "running", PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume false, BudgetUSD = Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator " + Phase}, {post start "<phase> resumed on a fresh session" numbers "session <id> · cap $<ClaudeUSD 'f' -1> · <Hours 'f' -1> h · " + Reason}]; Mode "diverged" or "error" → State "waiting", Stop = {Kind "git", Phase, Reason, At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), actions [{post stop "<phase> not started: git" numbers Reason}]. PhaseDone: State "running" or "paused" and phase == Phase → actions [{Kind "end_check", Phase}] (nothing else changes); otherwise (nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: phase_done %q while %s %q", ErrPhaseMismatch, phase, State, Phase)). EndChecked (State "running" or "paused"; else nil): e.OK → StretchUSD += SessionUSD; out, err := Queue.Done(Phase, next) where next is the id after the current one in Queue.Phases (or "") — err is impossible here and ignored; actions start with [{Kind "kill"}]; then by out: Next and no Stop → the loop begins that phase at once (the Begin transition: Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0): Phase = out.Next, State "starting", SessionID "", actions += [{Kind "start_check", Phase: out.Next}] (Queue.Start() called); Stop "smoke" or "operator" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind out.Stop, Phase: the finished phase, Reason "stop after " + out.Stop, At now}, actions += [{post stop "<phase> done: stop after <kind>" numbers "next <out.Next> · waiting for continue"}]; Stop "end" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "end", Phase, Reason "plan complete", At now}, actions += [{post end "<phase> done: plan complete" numbers "stretch $<StretchUSD 'f' 4>"}]. e not OK → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "not_pushed", Phase, Reason: e.Problems joined with "; ", At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), no kill, actions [{post stop "<phase> not pushed" numbers Reason}]. WaitOperator: State "running" or "paused" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind: kind, Phase, Reason, IssueURL, At now}, Queue.Stop(kind), actions [{post stop "<phase>: wait_operator <kind>" numbers = reason, then " · " + issueURL when non-empty}]; other states → nil. Continue: State must be "waiting" else (nil, control.ErrNotWaiting); Stop.Kind "not_pushed" → Queue.Continue() then Queue.Start() (the queue runs the same phase again), actions [{end_check Phase}] with State "running" and Stop nil; otherwise Queue.Continue() (its error returned as is) then the Begin transition (Queue.Start, Phase = its id, State "starting", Stop nil, …, actions [{start_check}]); the session id is drawn in StartChecked, so neither Begin nor Continue takes an id source. Restart: State "running" or "paused" → actions [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase}], State "starting", SessionID "", Restarts nil (the PM's explicit restart resets the count; LastExit kept); "idle", "starting" or "waiting" → (nil, control.ErrNoSession).

Steps:
- uses: queue
- uses: gitrules
- uses: control
- produces: Loop Action

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given q, _ := queue.Load(the queue.Plan decoded from tests/fixtures/plan/queue-3.json, queue.Caps{ClaudeUSD: 30, Hours: 3, ExecutorUSD: 5}) (phases P17 none, P18 smoke with Caps.ClaudeUSD 12, P19 none; State "queued"); l := New("demo", q) with l.Restarts set to [2026-10-08T14:00:00Z] and l.LastExit to &control.Exit{Code: 7, At: 2026-10-08T14:00:00Z, Stderr: "old", Restarts: 1} before the call; ids := a func returning "id-1", "id-2", … in turn; when l.Begin(2026-10-08T15:00:00Z); then actions exactly [{Kind "start_check", Phase "P17"}], nil; State "starting", Phase "P17", Queue.State "running", Restarts nil ([]time.Time(nil)), LastExit nil; a second Begin → error text "queue: cannot start in state \"running\"" and no change (ref: tests/fixtures/plan/queue-3.json)
2. given the loop after example 1 (State "starting", P17) with l.Restarts set to [2026-10-08T14:50:00Z] and l.LastExit to &control.Exit{Code: 1, At: 2026-10-08T14:50:00Z, Stderr: "boom", Restarts: 1} before the call; StartChecked(gitrules.Start{Mode: "fresh", Local: "aaa111", Remote: "aaa111"}, ids, 15:00:01Z); when StartChecked; then exactly [{Kind "spawn", Phase "P17", SessionID "id-1", Resume false, BudgetUSD 30}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator P17"}, {Kind "post", Milestone {start, "P17 started", "session id-1 · cap $30 · 3 h"}}]; State "running", SessionID "id-1", PhaseStartedAt 15:00:01Z; Restarts still exactly [14:50:00Z] and LastExit still that Exit (a fresh start keeps the restart count)
3. given a loop in State "starting" for P18 with SessionID "" (the loop at the end of example 5, or one built with its Queue at Index 1 and Queue.State "running"); StartChecked(Start{Mode: "resume", Reason: "local ahead of origin/main", Local: "bbb222", Remote: "aaa111"}, ids returning "id-7", 2026-10-08T15:45:00Z); when StartChecked; then exactly [{Kind "spawn", Phase "P18", SessionID "id-7", Resume false, BudgetUSD 12}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator P18"}, {post start "P18 resumed on a fresh session" "session id-7 · cap $12 · 3 h · local ahead of origin/main"}] (no conversation to resume: a fresh session, never Resume true with a new id); State "running", SessionID "id-7", PhaseStartedAt 15:45:00Z, LastEventAt 15:45:00Z
4. given a loop in State "starting" for P17 (the loop after example 1); StartChecked(Start{Mode: "diverged", Reason: "local aaa111 and origin/main ccc333 diverged"}, ids, 2026-10-08T15:02:00Z); when StartChecked; then [{post stop "P17 not started: git" "local aaa111 and origin/main ccc333 diverged"}]; State "waiting", Stop {Kind "git", Phase "P17", Reason as given, At 15:02:00Z}, Queue.State "stopped"
5. given the running loop of example 2 (P17, session id-1); PhaseDone("P17", "P18"); then EndChecked(End{OK: true, Local: "ddd", Remote: "ddd", Problems: []}, 15:40:00Z); when PhaseDone then EndChecked; then PhaseDone → [{Kind "end_check", Phase "P17"}], nil; EndChecked → exactly [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase "P18"}]; State "starting", Phase "P18", SessionID "", Queue.Index 1, Queue.State "running"
6. given the running loop of example 2; PhaseDone("P16", "P17"); then a loop in State "waiting" with PhaseDone("P17", "P18"); when PhaseDone; then errors.Is ErrPhaseMismatch with text "phase mismatch: phase_done \"P16\" while running \"P17\""; then text "phase mismatch: phase_done \"P17\" while waiting \"P17\""
7. given the running loop of example 2 with SessionUSD 1.92; EndChecked(End{OK: false, Problems: ["not pushed: HEAD bbb222, origin/main aaa111"]}, 2026-10-08T16:00:00Z); when EndChecked; then exactly [{post stop "P17 not pushed" "not pushed: HEAD bbb222, origin/main aaa111"}] (no kill); State "waiting", Stop {Kind "not_pushed", Phase "P17", Reason "not pushed: HEAD bbb222, origin/main aaa111", At 16:00:00Z}, StretchUSD 0, Queue.State "stopped"; then Continue(16:05:00Z) → [{end_check P17}], State "running", Stop nil, Queue.State "running", Queue.Index 0; then EndChecked(End{OK: true, Problems: []}, 16:10:00Z) → exactly [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase "P18"}], StretchUSD 1.92, SessionUSD 0
8. given a running loop at P18 (Index 1 of the fixture queue, SessionUSD 0.5, StretchUSD 1.0); EndChecked(OK true) at 17:00:00Z; then Continue(17:30:00Z); then a running loop at P19 with EndChecked(OK true); when EndChecked; Continue; EndChecked; then [{kill}, {post stop "P18 done: stop after smoke" "next P19 · waiting for continue"}], State "waiting", Stop.Kind "smoke", StretchUSD 1.5; Continue → [{start_check P19}], State "starting", Phase "P19", nil; the P19 end → [{kill}, {post end "P19 done: plan complete" "stretch $1.5000"}], State "waiting", Stop.Kind "end", Queue.State "done"; a Continue then → error text "queue: nothing to continue (state \"done\")"
9. given the running loop of example 2; WaitOperator("gate", "forecast $1.4 over the cap", "", 15:10:00Z); then on a fresh running loop WaitOperator("emergency", "card x red after fix", "https://github.com/o/r/issues/12", now); then Restart on the waiting loop; then Restart on a running loop whose Restarts is [15:05:00Z] and LastExit &control.Exit{Code: 3, At: 15:05:00Z, Stderr: "", Restarts: 1}; when WaitOperator; Restart; then [{post stop "P17: wait_operator gate" "forecast $1.4 over the cap"}], State "waiting", Stop {gate, P17, "forecast $1.4 over the cap", IssueURL ""}; then numbers "card x red after fix · https://github.com/o/r/issues/12" and Stop.IssueURL set; Restart → (nil, control.ErrNoSession); on the running loop → [{kill}, {start_check P17}], State "starting", SessionID "", Restarts nil ([]time.Time(nil)), LastExit still that Exit
10. given the running loop of example 2 (P17, SessionID "id-1") with l.State set to "starting" directly (as Runtime Guard's Exited leaves it after an exit); ids := a func counting its calls and returning "id-9"; StartChecked(Start{Mode: "resume", Reason: "dirty tree (1 paths)"}, ids, 2026-10-08T15:21:00Z); when StartChecked; then exactly [{Kind "spawn", Phase "P17", SessionID "id-1", Resume true, BudgetUSD 30}, {post start "P17 resumed" "session id-1 · dirty tree (1 paths)"}] — no first_line; SessionID still "id-1", ids called 0 times; State "running", PhaseStartedAt 15:21:00Z, LastEventAt 15:21:00Z
11. given the running loop of example 2; Restart(2026-10-08T15:30:00Z); then ids := a func counting its calls and returning "id-2"; StartChecked(Start{Mode: "resume", Reason: "on branch morph/20261008-083312", Branch: "morph/20261008-083312"}, ids, 15:30:05Z); when Restart then StartChecked; then Restart → [{Kind "kill"}, {Kind "start_check", Phase "P17"}], nil, SessionID ""; StartChecked → exactly [{Kind "spawn", Phase "P17", SessionID "id-2", Resume false, BudgetUSD 30}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator P17"}, {post start "P17 resumed on a fresh session" "session id-2 · cap $30 · 3 h · on branch morph/20261008-083312"}]; State "running", SessionID "id-2", ids called once, PhaseStartedAt 15:30:05Z

type Action struct { Kind string; Phase string; SessionID string; Resume bool; BudgetUSD float64; Line string; Milestone control.Milestone }  // Kind: start_check | spawn | first_line | end_check | kill | post | write

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

Write the files: `supervisor/loop.go`.

Go 1.22, the standard library only (go.mod requires nothing; the build runs with GOPROXY=off). gofmt-formatted (gofmt -l prints nothing) and go vet clean. A file's package is its directory's base name; exported names in MixedCaps; a package imports another of the module by the module path of go.mod + "/" + its directory. Tests are `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` in the package's own `_test.go` files, table tests allowed; compare with `testhelp.Equal(t, what, got, want)` of the module's `internal/testhelp`, never your own helper; no t.Skip, no network, no clock, no goroutine left running.

Write ONLY the test file `supervisor/loop_examples_test.go`: one `func TestPhaseLoopExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `supervisor/loop.go` listed below (the examples of the Function), in example order. Do not write or modify any other file. Package supervisor; imports the standard library, `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/queue`, `morphstudio/gitrules` and `morphstudio/control` only; compare with `testhelp.Equal` (whole Action slices, *l.Stop as a control.Stop value, fields). Restarts is []time.Time and LastExit *control.Exit: where an example says they are set before a call, assign them directly on the loop (l.Restarts = []time.Time{...}; l.LastExit = &control.Exit{...}); compare Restarts whole (an expected nil is `[]time.Time(nil)`) and LastExit as *l.LastExit against a control.Exit value after checking l.LastExit != nil (an expected nil by l.LastExit == nil). The queue: os.ReadFile("../tests/fixtures/plan/queue-3.json"), json.Unmarshal into queue.Plan, queue.Load(plan, queue.Caps{ClaudeUSD: 30, Hours: 3, ExecutorUSD: 5}). Arities: Begin, PhaseDone, Continue and Restart return ([]Action, error); StartChecked, EndChecked and WaitOperator return []Action only. Write every expected action as a full Action literal holding only the fields the record names (a post is Action{Kind: "post", Milestone: control.Milestone{Kind: ..., Headline: ..., Numbers: ...}}) and every headline, numbers string and error text as one whole string literal; an expected nil slice is `[]Action(nil)`, never a bare nil; errors by errors.Is and their Error() text. Times are time.Date(2026, 10, 8, h, m, s, 0, time.UTC). Where an example counts the calls of ids, ids is a closure over an int counter (`calls++`) returning the literal id; check the counter after the call. Where an example sets l.State directly, assign the field. Another test file of package supervisor declares its own helpers: name every helper of this file with the prefix `pl` (e.g. `plRunning`). Go 1.25, gofmt-formatted.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Phase Loop example 1".
